sources.selection: Rows Melotte_22 (Pleiades) and Melotte_25 (Hyades); all published columns. The CWNU_1242 row on the Hyades sightline is a distinct group 290 pc away and is not used. Rows NGC_2632 (Beehive Cluster), NGC_869, NGC_884 (Double Cluster), NGC_2682 (M67) and NGC_3532 were added on 2026-11-18 while every VizieR mirror was unreachable, from the full clusters table redistributed as hunt24.csv with Zenodo record 19177686 (https://zenodo.org/records/19177686). That copy matches the two VizieR rows above in every shared column. It lacks the VizieR recno and computed _RA.icrs/_DE.icrs, which stay empty in the added rows. The NGC_869 radial velocity (6 stars) and NGC_884 radial velocity (2 stars) are not adopted; both use Dalessandro et al. (2021). Row Trumpler_14 was added on 2026-11-19 from the same Zenodo copy (hunt24.csv, record 19177686), with RAdeg and DEdeg written as RA_ICRS and DE_ICRS; its distance is not used (Maíz Apellániz et al. 2022 instead).

Rows Melotte 22 and Melotte 25; the high-quality-sample [Fe/H] is adopted. Rows NGC 2632, NGC 2682 and NGC 3532 were added on 2026-11-18 from the table “Metallicities of the open clusters” in the arXiv source (arXiv:1511.08884v1), as the VizieR mirrors were unreachable; its Melotte 22 and Melotte 25 rows match VizieR. recno, _RA and _DE stay empty. NGC 869 and NGC 884 are not in the table.

Center (Goldsbury et al. 2010; Lanzoni et al. 2010 for Ter 5), distance (Baumgardt & Vasiliev 2021), mass, core radius (Spitzer 1987 definition), projected half-light radius, 3D half-mass radius and tidal radius from parameter.html; radial velocity and Gaia EDR3 proper motion (Vasiliev & Baumgardt 2021) from orbits.html. sources.selection: Rows NGC104, NGC5139, NGC6121, NGC6205, NGC6656, NGC7078 and Ter5.
